newsitem.title: USA: Vanstar plans preferred trust offering.
newsitem.headline: Vanstar plans preferred trust offering.

text.p: Vanstar Corp said late Tuesday it planned a refinancing plan that includes an offer of about $125 million of convertible preferred trust interests and the securitization of account receivables.
The company said it does not anticipate that these transactions, taken together, will be dilutive to earnings.

The net proceeds of the offering are anticipated to be used to repay a portion of Vanstar's existing long-term debt as part of a refinancing plan aimed at converting a substantial portion of its long-term variable rate debt to fixed rate debt and reducing its overall interest costs.

The trust interests will entitle holders to quarterly distribution payments and will be convertible to shares of Vanstar common stock. The offering could reach $150 million if the over-allotment option is exercised in full.

The company said it plans to repay the remainder of Vanstar's long-term indebtedness with proceeds of an accounts receivable-based asset securitization transaction to be implemented promptly following consummation of the offering.
It said it expects to complete the refinancing plan, including the offering and the asset securitization transaction, during the course of its current fiscal quarter.

The company said the offering would be made within the United States to qualified institutional buyers and a limited number of other institutional accredited investors and outside the United States to foreign investors.
